Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Bangladesh players make their way out on the middle. Followed by Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz who walk out to open for Afghanistan. It will be Shakib Al Hasan to start with the new ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. Afghanistan does not have a stiff mountain to climb here. They will surely back their batters to chase this down. Also, lets not forgot about the dew in play. Bangladesh need to start well with the ball to make something of the game. Do join us to find out how things pan out in the second essay.

Rashid Khan is in for a quick chat. He starts by thanking God for his performance and says that it is all about performing for the team and whenever they need him, he tries to keep it simple. Adds that it is hard on this wicket to play shots off the back foot and they had a talk about it. Says that once Mujeeb bowled that first over, they were mindful of the length and stuck to it. Adds that they need to play positive cricket and regardless of what happens, it is important to go out and express yourself.

Afghanistan were brilliant with the ball. They kept asking the right questions and made the batters work hard for runs. The two leg spinners, Mujeeb Ur Rahman and Rashid Khan completely dismantled the Bangladeshi attack. The former ran riot with the new ball, while the latter dominated the proceedings in the middle overs. They both took three wickets each. Afghanistan were also brilliant in the field throughout the innings.

Bangladesh were off to a horrific start. They had the supporters on their back but the batters could not keep up with the pressure from the opposition. They certainly lacked partnerships in the middle which lead them to a below-par score. They lost three wickets inside the Powerplay and were unable to stable the ship ever since. Mosaddek Hossain added some impetus to the total with his brisk innings of 48 runs. The bowler's don't have much to fight for but will come out with an aggressive intent. A few early wickets and it could turn up the heat in Sharjah.

Afghanistan were on top for the most part of the innings. They will be a bit hurt with the way they leaked runs in the death overs but nonetheless would be the happier side going into the break. Bangladesh would've ended below 100 runs if not for Mosaddek Hossain's innings.

What an excellent delivery to finish off the innings by Azmatullah Omarzai and he concedes just 7 runs! This is a pacy wide yorker, perfectly bowled, just inside the tramline. Mosaddek Hossain backs away and leaves it in hopes of it being called a wide but it was just perfect. Mosaddek stays unbeaten on 48 and Bangladesh end with 127/7 on the board!

OUT! RUN OUT! A misunderstanding in the middle and Mahedi Hasan has to go back to the hut. This is a bouncer, on middle, Mahedi Hasan looks to pull it but misses and the ball carries towards the keeper. However, Mosaddek Hossain wants the run and sets off, Hasan did not see him untill he is already in the batting end and moves out of his crease then. The keeper throws the ball back to the bowler and he does the rest. Also, Mohammad Saifuddin is the next batter but he will be at the non-striker's end.
FOUR! What a shot! This is full and on off, Mahedi Hasan thinks about playing the ramp shot, but adjusts well and scoops it over the keeper for a boundary.
A slower one, on a yorker length and on off, Mosaddek Hossain digs it to the right of he short third man felder but the fielder does well to stop it. They cross.
A low full toss, on middle, Mahedi Hasan drills it towards deep extra cover for just a run. Nabi does well to cut it out in the deep.
This is on a good length and on leg, Mosaddek Hossain slaps it towards long off for a single.

FOUR! Nice innovation! Fazalhaq Farooqi tries to go for the yorker, but misses and it ends up being a full toss on off, Mahedi Hasan moves across and ramps it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.

A low full toss, Mosaddek Hossain looks to work it to the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers. He sets off for the run, Nabi has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The batters get the run.
A slower one now, short and on middle, Mahedi Hasan waits for it and only manages to pull it towards short fine leg for a single.
Pulls his length back a bit and on off, Mosaddek Hossain clears his front leg and cuts it towards wide third man for a run.
Full again and around off, Mahedi Hasan mistimes his lofted drive through covers for another run.
Full and on off, Mosaddek Hossain drives it towards sweeper cover for just one.
Slower one, bowled into the deck and around off. Mahedi Hasan goes right across the off stump and looks to scoop it over the keeper's head but fails to make a connection.
Good comeback by Naveen! Nails the yorker on off stump, Mosaddek Hossain just about manages to get an inside edge onto the pads. The ball goes nowhere but the batters scamper through for a run.

FOUR! Mosaddek Hossain is getting Bangladesh closer and closer to a defendable total. Full and outside off, pace on and Mosaddek makes brilliant use of the pace. Mosaddek hangs deep and opens the face of the bat at the last moment to steer it past short third man for a boundary.
Slower delivery, very full and hugging the tramline outside off. Mahedi Hasan gets low and lofts it over covers for a single.
WIDE! Goes full and wide again but this time it's a bit too wide for the umpire's liking.
Excellent delivery! Pacy delivery, full and wide, Mahedi Hasan can't reach it.
Naveen-ul-Haq comes back into the attack and delivers a slower ball, shorter and outside off. This is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Very full and pace on this time, at the stumps. Mahedi Hasan just blocks it back towards the bowler.
Another full toss, outside off and dipping on the batter. Mosaddek Hossain slaps it towards deep point for just a single this time.
Smart from Mahedi Hasan, just turning the strike over. Slower again, on a length and pushed wider. This is tapped towards cover-point for one more.
Another slower delivery and on the shorter side, close to the off pole. Mosaddek waits for it and plays it towards short third man for a run.

FOUR! Mosaddek Hossain keeps on punishing the bad deliveries. With point and third man inside the circle, Fazalhaq Farooqi serves a juicy full toss outside off. Mosaddek just opens the face of the bat and steers it behind point for a boundary.
Almost 4 overs left now! Bangladesh will be looking to go all guns-blazing in the death now. They have nothing to lose here. Can Afghanistan continue to pile up the pressure?
Farooqi starts off the new spell with a slower delivery, bowled into the deck and on off. Mahedi Hasan hangs back and keeps it down on the off side, scampering across for a single as well.

FOUR! Quicker one, down the leg side, Mosaddek Hossain manages to get a bit of bat on it and the ball races past the diving fielder at short fine leg for a boundary. Mosaddek holds the key now for Bangladesh.
A googly now, sliding onto the pads, Mosaddek Hossain tickles it past the man at short fine leg and the batters get a couple of runs.
Mahedi Hasan is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Ibrahim Zadran takes a fine catch in the deep and Mahmudullah has to depart! He tries to take on Rashid, but holes out this time. This is floated, full and on leg, turning away a bit, Mahmudullah tries to go for the slog-sweep against the spin, but gets it more of his bottom of the bat. The ball goes up in the air and towards deep mid-wicket where Ibrahim Zadran moves towards the ball, dives forward and takes a good catch. This shot was not needed at all considering this is the last over of Rashid. Bangladesh lose their sixth now.
Commentary.Howout: c Ibrahim Zadran b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Fullish length around off, Mosaddek Hossain just bunts it out towards silly mid on and sets off for a quick single.

NOT OUT! This is flighted, full and on middle, turning away, Mosaddek Hossain makes room to slog it over extra cover, but misses. The keeper is quick to gather and takes the bails off. There is an appeal for stumping and the umpires sends it upstairs. They UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved. The replays shows that Mosaddek Hossain has managed to keep some part of his boot behind the line when the wickets are broken. He survives.

Is it stumped? The square leg umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The UltraEdge first confirms that there is no bat involved. The side-on angle shows that Mosaddek Hossain has his back leg grounded and some part is behind the crease as well. The big screen shows NOT OUT. Everything going Bangladesh's way now. Will they be able to make the most of the momentum here?
Tossed up, full and on middle, Mahmudullah drills it towards wide long on for a single.
Change. Rashid Khan (3-0-14-2) comes back into the attack.
Another single to end the over as this full delivery is flicked away through mid-wicket by Mahmudullah.
Bangs in short this time, on off, Mosaddek Hossain pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one more.
This is almost on a yorker length and on off, Mahmudullah moves across and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish one and on off, Mosaddek Hossain wristily flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on middle, Mosaddek Hossain knocks it back to the bowler.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for Bangladesh! This is pitched up and on middle, Mosaddek Hossain stays there and flicks it fine past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. This was a risky shot as well because if he would have missed the ball, he would been plumb in front.
Change. Naveen-ul-Haq (2-0-15-0) is back into the attack now.
Flatter delivery, close to the off pole, Mahmudullah backs away and dabs it down to short third man. Bangladesh need to start looking for boundaries now.
On the shorter side and around the pads, this is played off the back foot and through mid-wicket for a single.

Sloppy back-up and it allows an extra run. On the pads, tucked away past square leg for a single. The throw at the bowler's end is a bit wide and the fielder backing up slips, letting the ball through and Bangladesh will get a couple of runs in total.
A tad quicker and shorter this time, around off. Mahmudullah goes deep in his crease and guides it down to third man for a single.
Turning it onto the pads, wristed away through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Good running!
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back for his final over and starts off with a length ball on leg stump. Mosaddek Hossain stays back and eases it through wide mid on for a single.
A tad shorter and at the stumps, this is pulled away in front of mid-wicket for a run.

Nicely tossed up, around middle, Mosaddek Hossain skips down the track and plays an inside-out cover drive. The ball seems to be heading towards the fence but Fazalhaq Farooqi from sweeper cover runs around to his right and keeps it down to a brace.
This is bowled onto the pads, Mahmudullah leans in and flicks it through square leg for just another single.
Flatter this time, close to the off pole. Mahmudullah backs away and dabs it down towards the man at short third man.
A googly now, fired in around middle and leg. Mosaddek Hossain steps out and then plays a checked-straight drive down to long off for a run.
This is fired in full and around off, played off the inner half of the bat onto the leg side for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Mosaddek Hossain works it towards the vacant mid-wicket region and comes back for the second.
Flatter and around off, Mosaddek Hossain pushes it towards covers.

SIX! Almost a spectacular catch but it ends up being a maximum by the smallest of margins and the crowd goes wild as well. Tossed up by Mohammad Nabi, around off and Mosaddek Hossain launches high in the evening sky. The ball almost flies over the long off fence but Azmatullah Omarzai runs to his right and takes it before flicking it back to Rashid Khan who came in from long on. The catch is checked by the third umpire and after a lot of replays, the third umpire concludes that Omarzai's foot touched the ropes just before he let go off the ball and Mosaddek survives.

Is that a clean catch? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The soft signal is OUT. After several replays the third umpire is convinced that the fielders right leg touched the boundary cushion. The big screen shows NOT OUT and the crowd is loving it.
Short and on middle and leg, Mahmudullah makes room and cuts it towards deep point for one more.
Another single as this short delivery is pushed towards long on.
A bit short and on middle, Mahmudullah goes back and eases it towards long on for one.
Floated and around off, short too, Mahmudullah punches it off the back foot through covers for a single. End of another successful over for Afghanistan.
Tossed up, full and around off, Mahmudullah late cuts it towards short third man.
This is bowled around off, Mosaddek Hossain steps out and gets an inside edge behind square on the leg side for a single.
Mosaddek Hossain comes in at number 7.

OUT! LBW! Rashid Khan strikes again. The break works in favour of the fielding team again. This is the googly, flatter and quicker, on middle, skids through the surface, Afif Hossain gets cramped in his crease and tries to work it away to the leg side. He misses the ball and gets hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. There is a huge appeal for LBW and the finger goes up. It looks plumb as well. However, Afif Hossain still goes for the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows three reds. Bangladesh lose half their side now.
Floated, full and on middle, Mahmudullah tucks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mahmudullah goes for the big heave over mid-wicket but gets it off the inside edge through square leg for a brace. Good running between the wickets!

Drinks break! We are halfway through the first innings and Afghanistan have completely bossed the game so far. Mujeeb Ur Rahman has been simply sensational and has managed to pick up 3 wickets. Rashid Khan too has just bowled one over and has one wicket to his name. Bangladesh just a have couple of more decent batters to follow and a lot rests on the shoulders of Afif Hossain and Mahmudullah. Can they stitch some sort of a comeback? Well, Rashid Khan is back into the attack for Afghanistan now.
So 50 is up for Bangladesh at the end of 10 overs. It is full, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah clips it to long on for an easy single.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Bangladesh. It is floated, drifting down leg. Mahmudullah goes back and glances it down to fine leg. A fielder gives it a chase but the ball wins the race.
Second dot of the over! It is looped up, on off. Mahmudullah shuffles across and flicks it to mid-wicket. Not in the gap though.
On the stumps, this is flicked to square leg for just a single.
Brilliant fielding! Tossed up, full and on off. Afif Hossain reverse-sweeps it to deep point. The fielder in the deep dives to make a sharp stop. They take two.
A dot to start with! Full and on off. Afif Hossain reverse sweeps it to backward point.
Shorter, on off, Hossain pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. A decent over for Bangladesh, just 7 runs off it.
It is a length ball, on off. Hossain pushes it gently towards mid off. The fielder there slips and the batters take a couple. Looks like the dew is out, as the towel can be seen now.
Another single now! Fuller, on the stumps. Mahmudullah flicks it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
Length ball, on middle stump. Hossain goes back and clips it to the left of mid on. They take one.
Full length, on middle and leg. Mahmudullah stays back and flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.

LEG BYE! Naveen-ul-Haq goes full, on leg. Afif Hossain fails to flick it away. It goes to square leg off his pads. Naveen-ul-Haq makes a stifled appeal but the umpire shows no interest. They collect a leg bye.

In the air...safe! This is floated, full and outside off, Afif Hossain makes room and slashes at it. The ball goes of the outer half towards sweeper cover, but falls well short of the fielder. A single taken.
Fires this full and on the pads, Afif Hossain flicks it towards short fine leg.
Short and on off, Mahmudullah punches it off the backfoot through covers for one.
Nabi follows the batter well here, Afif Hossain makes room to the leg side, Nabi darts a full delivery, on leg, Afif Hossain tucks it towards square leg for one.
A bit short and on middle, turning in, Mahmudullah pushes it with soft hands towards point and gets a quick single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mahmudullah uses his feet and knocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Will Mujeeb Ur Rahman be brought in to finish his spell in search of a wicket? No, the skipper Mohammad Nabi brings himself into the attack.
Another googly, full and on off, Mahmudullah gets to the pitch of it and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker again, short and on middle, Mahmudullah knocks it to the leg side.
Floated, full and on off, Afif Hossain pushes it towards covers for a quick single.

Edgy start! Nicely tossed up, full and outside off, it is the googly and Mahmudullah attempts the extravagant drive. The ball goes off the inside edge and towards square leg as the batters get a single.
Mahmudullah is in at number 6.

OUT! LBW! Rashid Khan strikes in his very first over. This is the googly, flatter and on middle, turning in, Mushfiqur Rahim goes to block it but plays down the wrong line. He gets rapped on his pads. There is a huge appeal for LBW but turned down. Rashid Khan is confident and convinces Nabi to take the review. The UltraEdge shows that there is not bat involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds and Rahim has to walk back to the hut.
Starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Mushfiqur Rahim blocks it onto the ground.
Rashid Khan is now brought into the attack.
Drags the length back and bowls it around the pads, Mushfiqur Rahim goes deep in his crease and tucks it away through square leg for a run. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 28/3!
Leg bye! This is floated up on the pads, Afif Hossain looks to work it behind square but misses. The ball rolls off his pads onto the leg side and the batters scamper through for a run.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Afif Hossain tries to go for the reverse sweep but mistimes it towards covers.
A beautiful shot to get off the mark! This flatter and quicker and around off, Afif Hossain uses the pace and guides it towards the third man region for a brace.
Afif Hossain comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Mujeeb Ur Rahman is on fire out there in the desert and picks up his third wicket! Shakib Al Hasan walks right across the leg stump and exposes his stumps. Mujeeb is aware of it and fires one in around middle and this one comes in with the angle. Shakib misses the cut and the ball castles into middle and leg. Bangladesh in a spot of bother here and Afghanistan on top of proceedings.
Quicker and flatter, around off, Shakib Al Hasan rocks back and cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
Staying a touch low! Full and well outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim looks to go after it but the ball sneaks under his willow.
A tad slower and close to the off pole. Shakib Al Hasan waits for it and cuts it close to his body towards deep point for a single.
Keeps it a bit fuller and serves it on middle and leg, Shakib defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Back-to-back! Fullish length, angling across the left-hander, Shakib Al Hasan makes a bit of room and crunches it through the cover region for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! This is pitched up on leg stump, Shakib Al Hasan clears the front leg and lofts it over wide mid on for a boundary.
Starts off with a length ball, around off and skidding through. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and cuts it square towards the man at cover-point.
Naveen-ul-Haq comes into bowl now as Mushfiqur Rahim walks in at number 4.

OUT! LBW! A huge appeal for LBW but turned down! Mohammad Nabi is convinced by his bowler. He takes the review and Afghanistan get their second wicket. Mujeeb Ur Rahman has given his side the best start possible. It is much straighter and on middle. Anamul Haque looks to sweep it away but misses. He gets rapped on his pads. The bowler appeals and the finger stays low. Mohammad Nabi takes the review and the Ball Tracking confirms three reds. Bangladesh are in a spot of bother.
Tossed up, outside off. Anamul Haque looks to chase it but misses.
Full, on middle and leg. Anamul Haque flicks it to mid-wicket.
On off, pushed to the off side.
LEG BYE! On the pads, Shakib Al Hasan fails to flick it away. It goes off his pads and they collect a leg bye.
A single now as this is worked to mid on.
WIDE! This is sprayed down leg. Anamul Haque looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
On a length, around off. Shakib Al Hasan defends it out watchfully. A great over by Fazalhaq Farooqi just 3 runs off it.
Fuller, around middle. Haque pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
Full length, outside off. Haque taps it to mid off.
On off, blocked out.
A length ball, down leg. Haque hangs back and flicks it through square leg. A fielder gives it a chase and does well to keep it down to two.
Good length, around off. Haque stays back and dabs it down to backward point.
Shakib Al Hasan, the skipper walks in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Mujeeb Ur Rahman continues to dominate with the new ball. He draws the first blood here. Mohammad Naim has to walk back on just 6. Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes 'round the wicket for the left-hander. It is arm ball, around off, that comes in with the angle. It skids on. Mohammad Naim is in no position to play the drive but still goes for it and the ball goes past his blade to rattle the stumps.
A single now as this is eased down to long on.
Floated and outside off. Anamul Haque looks to drive it away but gets beaten.
On middle and leg. Haque taps it to the right of the bowler. Mujeeb Ur Rahman moves to that side and stop it.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman serves it outside off, a seam up delivery. Anamul Haque looks to chase it but misses.
Full, down leg. Naim clips it to deep square leg and crosses for one.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman to share the new ball with Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Length ball, outside off. Naim gets an inside edge and it dies instantly on the off side. The batters scamper through for a quick single. 5 runs off the over then.

Swing and a miss! This has been a solid comeback from Fazalhaq Farooqi. Good-length ball, outside off. Not much pace on offer. Naim looks to cut it away but misses. The ball dies as it reaches the keeper.
Almost chops on this time! A length ball, around off. It is too close to cut. Naim hangs back and still look to cut it away. It takes an inside edge and bounces past the stumps.
FOUR! This should give him some confidence. The crowd erupts as the ball races away. It is a full toss, on middle and leg. Naim gets behind and lofts it past mid on for four.
Two dots in a row! Full length, wide outside off. Naim looks to thrash it past mid off but mistimes it.
Fazalhaq Farooqi goes full, outside off, with some hint of out swing. Mohammad Naim leans in and pushes it to covers.

Done with the pre-game formalities and we are now ready for play to begin. The umpires are out in the middle and the Afghan players can be seen in a huddle. Mohammad Naim and Anamul Haque are set to open the innings for Bangladesh. It will be the star of the previous game, Fazalhaq Farooqi to get proceedings underway with the ball for Afghanistan. Let's play...

We are minutes away from the start of play! But before the game begins, the umpires and the two sets of players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's national anthem first followed by the national anthem of Bangladesh.

Allan Donald, the fast-bowling coach of Bangladesh is in for a chat. He says they have trained for three very tough days in Dhaka and four days in the ICC venues. Adds they are very well prepared, and now is the time to put the performance on the pitch. Mentions that they have lost crucial wickets in the Powerplay and that needs to improve. Ends by saying they are pretty good in their bowling in the Powerplays but now they need to control the game in the middle phase of matches.

PITCH REPORT - Scott Styris is near the deck. He says that it is a fresh deck. There is sheen across the deck as well. Adds that the boundaries are small. Ends by saying it is a great surface to bat on.

Mohammad Nabi, the skipper of Afghanistan is in for a chat. He says that the wicket is good and they will aim to restrict them to a low score. Mentions the morale of the team is high and hopefully they continue in the same manner. Further says that they are sticking to the same side. Mentions it is a slow pitch also a fresh one. Ends by saying they will try their best to keep them to a low total.

Shakib Al Hasan, the captain of Bangladesh says that they will bat first. Mentions that it looks like a good wicket and will be a bit difficult for Afghanistan to put score on the board. Adds that their bowling pack seems to be in rhythm and now it is only about moving up with the momentum. Says that Asia Cup is a great platform and the rivalry between the neighbouring countries makes it more intriguing.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Anamul Haque, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Afif Hossain, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Mosaddek Hossain, Mahmudullah, Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Mustafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed.

Afghanistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran, Karim Janat, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Rashid Khan, Azmatullah Omarzai, Naveen-ul-Haq, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi.
TOSS - Bangladesh have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Bangladesh come into this game on the back of some really poor performances in T20I matches, but their regular skipper, Shakib Al Hasan, is back in the team and will look to provide that leadership that his team has lacked in recent times. They will face a tough opposition who are flying high, but Bangladesh do have players that can beat any side on their day. Will Bangladesh be able to start off with a win? Or will Afghanistan continue their march? We'll find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.
